verdict.rationale: Twenty ships built-in Company and Person objects with relations between any objects, including many-to-many. Connected Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 emails and calendar events automatically appear on, and link to, the matching Company and People records, which delivers the core of linked records with activity on each. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a unified per-record activity timeline (notes, tasks, field-change history), an explicit statement of the Person-to-Company relation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
